# Release Command Results

[Source plan](./plan.md)

This capability applies the [Human Experience Contract](make-docs://system/contract/human-experience-contract.md) and uses [HX-DIR-01](./design.md#human-experience-intent) as its source promise.

### R-REL-01

For a completed, partial, or failed release, the installed command must show the product name, the release state in plain language, and the next safe action before it shows an internal build identifier.
